title: Bounded Semantic Planning and Deterministic Compilation for Reliable Enterprise Text-to-SQL
abstract: arXiv:2608.16663v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Direct text-to-SQL asks a language model to do two jobs: interpret the business question and construct the complete relational query. In enterprise schemas, SQL can execute successfully while using the wrong relationship role or aggregation grain. We study an alternative placement of the stochastic boundary. A multi-turn planner grounds phrases and selects from question-specific governed options; graph traversal, role predicates, grain lowering, SQL construction, and deterministic checks are implemented in code. We evaluate this semantic path compilation (SPC) system against direct DDL-to-SQL generation on the ACME insurance benchmark. On a 38-question adjudicated comparison set with three runs per question, SPC was adjudicated correct on every run for 37 questions (97.4%), compared with 21 (55.3%) for the baseline. The paired discordance was 16 questions in favor of SPC and none in favor of the baseline (two-sided exact McNemar p=3.05

translated_title: 面向可靠企业文本到SQL的边界语义规划与确定性编译
translated_abstract: 直接文本到SQL要求语言模型完成两项工作：解释业务问题并构建完整的关系查询。在企业模式中，SQL可能成功执行，但使用了错误的角色关系或聚合粒度。我们研究了一种替代的随机边界放置方式。一个多轮规划器将短语进行语义落地，并从问题特定的受控选项中进行选择；图遍历、角色谓词、粒度降低、SQL构建和确定性检查均在代码中实现。我们在ACME保险基准上评估了这种语义路径编译（SPC）系统，与直接DDL到SQL生成进行对比。在38个问题、每问题三次运行的裁定比较集中，SPC在37个问题（97.4%）的每次运行中被裁定正确，而基线为21个问题（55.3%）。配对不一致性为16个问题支持SPC，无问题支持基线（双侧精确McNemar检验p=3.05）。
tldr: 该系统通过将文本到SQL的随机过程转移到多轮语义规划与确定性代码编译，显著提升了企业复杂查询的可靠性，在基准测试中正确率从55.3%提升至97.4%。
en_tdlr: This system shifts the stochastic process of text-to-SQL to multi-turn semantic planning with deterministic code compilation, dramatically improving reliability for enterprise queries from 55.3% to 97.4% accuracy on the benchmark.
